David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Jeroboam_1: Solomon's servant, son of Nebat, who rebelled against him (1 Kings 11:26), and was later made king of Israel (1 Kings 12:20)
Nebat_1: father of Jeroboam, an Ephraimite of Zeredah (1 Kings 11:26)
Jehu_2: anointed king over Israel (1 Kings 19:16) at the direction of Elisha (2 Kings 9:1-3)
Amaziah_1: King of Judah, son of Joash (2 Kings 12:21)
Jeroboam_2: King of Israel (2 Kings 13:13), son of Joash [Jehoash] (2 Kings 14:16)
Azariah_3: [Uzziah] King of Judah, son of Amaziah (2 Kings 14:21)
Zechariah_1: King of Israel, son of Jeroboam (2 Kings 14:29)
Jotham_2: King of Judah, son of King Uzziah [Azariah_3] (2 Kings 15:30)
Shallum_1: conspired against King Zechariah and became king of Israel in his place (2 Kings 15:10)
Pekahiah_1: son of Menachem and King of Israel (2 Kings 15:22)
Pekah_1: son of Remaliah who killed King Pekahiah and became King of Israel in his place (2 Kings 15:25)
Argob_1: conspired with Pekah against Pekahiah (2 Kings 15:25)
Arieh_1: conspired with Pekah against Pekahiah (2 Kings 15:25)
Hoshea_1: son of Elah who killed King Pekah and became King of Israel in his place (2 Kings 15:30)
Elah_3: father of Hoshea, King of Israel (2 Kings 15:30)
Jerusha_1: mother of Jotham, King of Israel (2 Kings 15:33)
Ahaz_1: King of Judah, son of Jotham (2 Kings 15:38)
